headlines.headline: Thunder's title defense rocked by Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace surgeries
headlines.detail: Oklahoma City will be without Jalen Williams (fractured fibula, dislocated ankle) and Cason Wallace (torn labrum) for extended stretches after GM Sam Presti confirmed surgery for each; Alex Caruso also left Monday's win over Phoenix early with a right ankle sprain.

headlines.headline: Seahawks land All-Pro guard Quenton Nelson in trade with Colts
headlines.detail: Seattle acquired six-time All-Pro guard Quenton Nelson from Indianapolis for a 2027 third-round pick and a 2028 fifth, waiving incumbent guard Christian Haynes to make room. The 4-3 Seahawks remain in the running for Colts RB Jonathan Taylor too.

headlines.headline: Washington's QB situation stays unresolved days before first-ever trip to Nebraska
headlines.detail: Huskies coach Jedd Fisch again declined to name a starter between Demond Williams Jr. (fractured rib) and Elijah Brown, who threw three interceptions but still rallied Washington past Purdue 38-26 in relief. Nebraska is 5-2 (2-2 Big Ten) entering Saturday's meeting.

headlines.headline: Houston's roster exodus and Kansas's No. 1 recruit highlight a reassembled preseason Top 25
headlines.detail: Florida enters the season as the preseason AP No. 1 for the first time since 2006, with Duke second and Illinois third, but preseason No. 10 Houston lost four key rotation pieces while Kansas added five-star freshman Tyran Stokes, ESPN's No. 1 overall prospect.
